source: Crikey.
translation: 好家伙。
notes: Crikey 为英式惊叹，两个票价语境均适用。

source: If I rest in this bed tonight, my sleep will remain undisturbed.
translation: 今晚若在这张床上休息，我的睡眠便不会受到打扰。

source: Invariably. On this side of town.
translation: 一向如此。在城的这一边。

source: Something that was here has been erased by shadow. A map? A painting?
translation: 原本在这里的某样东西，已被阴影抹去。一幅地图？一幅画？

source: [Show British passport] My name is Spencer Hobson.
translation: [出示英国护照] 我叫斯宾塞·霍布森。

source: I'm afraid I've come out without any form of identification.
translation: 恐怕我出门时没带任何身份证明。

source: He says hello.
translation: 他向你问好。

source: ...did you set that up somehow?
translation: ……这是你想办法安排的吗？

source: Poking round his belongings would be embarrassing if I were caught, but I have my reasons. Petty larceny is something else entirely.
translation: 翻看他的东西，要是被逮住，场面会很难堪，但我自有理由。小偷小摸则完全是另一回事。
notes: 保留角色对窥探与盗窃所作的道德区分。

source: A charming young woman with, I dare say, unsuspected depths.
translation: 一位迷人的年轻女子，而且恕我直言，恐怕还深藏不露。

source: [A game of cards?]
translation: [来一局牌？]

source: Come in, my [[pilgrim]]; let's hear all your news.
translation: 进来吧，我的[[pilgrim]]；有什么新鲜事，都说来听听。
notes: 保留链接标识；all your news 按罗迪娅爽朗的口吻自然处理。

source: I suspected as much. For a while now, I have had my eye on that woman.
translation: 我早有怀疑。我盯着那个女人，已经有一阵子了。

source: I... said already that was not something I would do for you. You became very angry. You don't remember?
translation: 我……已经说过，我不会替你做那种事。你当时大发雷霆。你不记得了？

source: With regret, madame, I decline your offer.
translation: 很遗憾，夫人，我不能接受你的提议。

source: [Spontaneity] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation: [随性] 我来这里只为一桩小事。如今遇见了你，我有了一个好得多的理由。
notes: Spontaneity 开放终审采用“随性”，已完成词形统一。

source: Let's say I do.
translation: 姑且算我知道吧。

source: [Mock indignation] 'Many years?' Mademoiselle! I reject the absurdity!
translation: [佯装愤慨] “很多年？”小姐！这种荒唐说法，我可不认！
notes: 保留调情式假意抗议。

source: You are recalling folk-tales and fairy-stories in which an animal is recruited as a spy.
translation: 您是在回想那些让动物充当密探的民间故事和童话。

source: Vincent shrugs uneasily. 'Bad times.'
translation: 文森特不自在地耸耸肩。“年头不好。”

source: My summer suit! Made to measure; cut for lighter climates. Linen shirt and patch-pocket trousers, and a striped half-lined blazer.
translation: 我的夏装！量体裁制，适合炎热地区。一件亚麻衬衫、一条贴袋长裤，再加一件条纹半衬里西装外套。

source: [Mull a response.]
translation: [斟酌回应。]

source: I have my ways.
translation: 我自有办法。

source: The other hand, however, the one holding her cigarette, is almost clear of greenery.
translation: 不过，她夹着香烟的那只手几乎未被青绿侵染。
notes: 按自然中文重排同位语，避免无必要的成对破折号。

source: She's a member of staff? Not just a patient?
translation: 她是这里的工作人员？不只是病人？

source: Move even closer; bend down to examine her skin in detail.
translation: 再靠近些；俯身细看她的皮肤。

source: [I added something to their drinks - and something more to Philomèle's. Watch and wait to see the effect.]
translation: [我在他们的酒里加了点东西——菲洛梅勒那杯还多加了一样。且看会有什么效果。]

source: I'm looking for a woman - [[Nina Lagasse]]. I wonder if the Milice knows where to find her.
translation: 我在找一位女士——[[Nina Lagasse]]。不知道民兵团是否知道她的下落。
notes: Milice 依本作语境统一译为“民团”；以自然口语称“一位女士”，保留链接目标。；润色2026-08-18：Milice 统一为“民兵团”（chunk_001 定译）

source: My pilgrim. When a lady's seen the dawn, she's earned the right not to be questioned in on the dew. D'you follow me?
translation: 我的朝圣者。一个女人见过了黎明，便有权不被人追问露水。懂我的意思吗？
notes: seen the dawn / dew 疑有花期、性成熟或晨露意象的双关，正文保留含混。

source: What kind of work is this, madame? Is it, after all, a signaire that you want?
translation: 这究竟是什么活儿，夫人？说到底，您想要的还是一名西涅尔吗？
notes: signaire 按实际法语读音定译“西涅尔”。

source: Leopold is our painter. And our nihilist.
translation: 利奥波德是我们的画家。也是我们的虚无主义者。

source: Anyone? No? Sorry, [q=alias.familiar], it's beyond us, what you're talking about.
translation: 有吗？没有？抱歉，[q=alias.familiar]，你说的是什么，我们完全听不懂。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: [Mme Zèlia asked me to blight Philomèle. This is my chance.]
translation: [泽莉娅夫人要我加害菲洛梅勒。这正是机会。]

source: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

source: [Change your Outfit at the wardrobe; or just by entering your inventory anywhere in this room.]
translation: [在衣柜前更换装束；也可以在此房间任意位置打开物品栏更换。]

source: I am curious... and this is perhaps only a dream... very well. Share your secret, and I will share mine.
translation: 我确实好奇……而且这或许不过是一场梦……好吧。你告诉我你的秘密，我也告诉你我的。

source: I must warn you: this is a bad book. A very bad book.
translation: 我得先警告你：这是本坏书。坏透了的书。
notes: 保留 bad book 可兼指质量与危险性的含混。

source: [[Nina Lagasse]]. And whatever cash you might have in that desk of yours.
translation: [[Nina Lagasse]]。还有你这书桌里所有的现钱。
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: Invariably, it does not rain.
translation: 一如既往，并没有下雨。
notes: Invariably 的冷幽默语气依上下文保留。

source: ...that Hobson play? 'The Pilgrim Rose'?
translation: ……霍布森那部戏？《朝圣者玫瑰》？
notes: The Pilgrim Rose 统一为《朝圣者玫瑰》。

source: HORIZON, the poster reads. And below, in words from several languages: SUN - SEA - NIGHT - LINE - MORNING.
translation: 海报上写着“地平线”。下面则以数种语言写着：太阳——海——夜——线——清晨。

source: Finally.
translation: 终于。

source: [The night knows there is some small risk in sharing my name. But there may be no other way forward here.]
translation: [夜色知道，报上姓名总有一点风险。但眼下或许别无他路。]

source: Thank you, Milicien. Something else...
translation: 多谢，民兵先生。还有一件事……
notes: Milicien 为称呼，随 Milice 统一译。；润色2026-08-18：Milicien 统一为“民兵先生”

source: Examine the wall minutely.
translation: 细细检查墙面。

source: A flash of unexpected colour above the post office - flags rippling lazily in the dank air of the valley.
translation: 邮局上方蓦地闪出一抹异色——几面旗帜在山谷阴湿的空气中懒洋洋地飘动。

source: ...and every moment we spend to relieve it is a moment spent well.
translation: ……我们为减轻这痛苦而花的每一刻，都花得值得。

source: [Truth] Let's say I'm following my heart.
translation: [真话] 就当我是随心而行吧。

source: Murmur an invocation to the [[Watchman]]. See what might be revealed.
translation: 低声向[[Watchman]]祈告。看看会揭示出什么。
notes: 保留双中括号链接原文。

source: Well?
translation: 怎么？

source: Hi, Spence. What's the scene?!
translation: 嗨，斯宾斯。最近有什么热闹？！
notes: 保留 Bessy 对 Spencer 的昵称与俚俗活泼口吻。

source: This is a dream, is it not? How are you here?
translation: 这是梦，对不对？你怎么会在这里？

source: The doc's people?
translation: 医生手下的人？

source: [Follow Léon, cheerfully.]
translation: [兴高采烈地跟上莱昂。]

source: The richer the man, the harder to like. M. Strathcoyne [the name is much gallified] is very rich.
translation: 人越有钱，就越难讨人喜欢。斯特拉思科因先生[这个名字被法语化得厉害]非常有钱。
notes: gallified 指姓名高度法语化；保留源文方括号结构。

source: [The radio crackles and begins to fade... but almost immediately recovers. Mathis frowns, puzzled.]
translation: [收音机噼啪作响，声音开始淡去……但几乎立刻又恢复了。马蒂斯困惑地皱起眉头。]

source: You're back.
translation: 你又回来了。

source: Examine it more closely.
translation: 再仔细看看。

source: Romeo y Julieta Churchills -all the way from Cuba! They're not even rationed! They're just wildly unavailable. How did Strathcoyne come by them in a sanitarium in the unfavoured end of France?
translation: 罗密欧与朱丽叶牌丘吉尔雪茄——远道从古巴来的！倒不是配给品，只是根本无处可买。斯特拉思科因住在法国这块被遗忘的角落，究竟怎么弄到手的？
notes: Romeo y Julieta 为雪茄品牌，Churchills 为规格名。

source: The [[Cross]]-change, Mr Hobson. A final personal advancement. The efflorescence of a long-held secret.
translation: [[Cross]]之变，霍布森先生。个人晋升的最终阶段。一桩长久秘事的开花结果。
notes: 保留 [[Cross]] 链接；change 结合 advancement 开放终审采用“之变”。

source: [Cough.]
translation: [咳嗽。]

source: [Step through].
translation: [迈步穿过]。
notes: 保留源文句号位于方括号外的结构。

source: [Drop a little witchery into my glass along with the coins. Present it to Linou with a bow.]
translation: [连同硬币一起，往我的杯里添一点巫术。鞠躬呈给莉努。]

source: Mrrowr!!
translation: 喵嗷！！

source: [Look for [[Nina Lagasse]]. Until you find her, 'why' is less important than 'where'.]
translation: [去找[[Nina Lagasse]]。找到她以前，“为什么”不如“在哪里”要紧。]
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: But once, whispers the coming night, you were too slow.
translation: 然而将临的夜色低语：曾有一次，你迟了一步。

source: A mirror of bright silver returns my reflection with perfect fidelity. It does show me standing in a bombed-out version of the bathroom - one wall missing, plumbing dangling from the brickwork like angled entrails - but since the Wars, one learns not to be distracted by that kind of thing.
translation: 明亮的银镜分毫不差地映出我的倒影。它也确实映出我正站在被炸毁的浴室里——一面墙没了，水管从砖墙上悬下，活像歪斜的内脏——不过诸战之后，人们已经学会不被这类事分心。
notes: the Wars 为架空历史中的固定时期，统一译“诸战”，不擅加数量。

source: ...and you're trapped in a scrine, here in the Wake, because someone back in the Mansus has destroyed your scrineway. No fulgent would risk staying this long in a scrine of something as impermanent as ice.
translation: ……而你被困在醒时的一座灵龛里，因为漫宿那边有人毁掉了你的龛道。任何辉耀者都不会冒险在冰这样无常之物的灵龛里停留这么久。
notes: 终审：scrine／scrineway 定名“灵龛／龛道”，保留共同词根。

source: I assume they are expressions of fundamental incompatibility between distinct modes of being. Note their locations: on the border between two versions of Antibes.
translation: 我推测，它们是不同存在方式彼此根本不相容的表现。注意它们的位置：恰在两个版本的昂蒂布交界处。

source: [Potential] And then the War. So many dead, deported, lost. I was in no position to help.
translation: [潜在] 后来战争爆发。如此多人死去、被驱逐、失踪。我无力相助。
notes: Potential 沿前批统一译“潜在”。

source: Too much death, eh?
translation: 死的人太多了，嗯？

source: 'Land of Hope and Glory.'
translation: 《希望与光荣的土地》。
notes: Land of Hope and Glory 为英国爱国歌曲名。；润色2026-08-18：歌名与 chunk_003 统一为《希望与光荣的土地》

source: That is... that is contrary to the laws of war.
translation: 这……这违反战争法。

source: Take time to examine the radio.
translation: 花些时间检查收音机。

source: Very.
translation: 非常。

source: She closes her eyes for a moment, in pain or exultation.
translation: 她闭上眼睛片刻，不知是痛苦还是狂喜。

source: [Decide against it, at least for now.]
translation: [打消念头，至少暂时如此。]

source: 'Silence is silver. Speech is a wound.'
translation: “沉默是银。言语是伤口。”

source: [BE VALIANT!] FIFTEEN FRANCISQUES.
translation: [勇敢些！] 十五弗朗西斯克。
notes: francisque 为架空货币，开放终审采用音译“弗朗西斯克”，已完成开放终审。

source: [S'pose this means you're a Cynic. Although people change. Even Spencer Hobson.]
translation: [想来这表示你是个犬儒主义者。虽说人是会变的。就连斯宾塞·霍布森也会。]

source: So indeed.
translation: 正是如此。

source: We have made our arrangement. I'll keep to my word.
translation: 我们已经谈妥。我会信守诺言。

source: Pale as marble.
translation: 苍白如大理石。
notes: 保留源文尾随空格。

source: May he jolly well sort everything out!
translation: 那就让他好好把一切都收拾妥当吧！
notes: 保留 jolly well 带恼意的强调。

source: [Sincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation: [真心] 而你还得在外面执勤？真遗憾。

source: You're Greek?
translation: 你是希腊人？

source: A red-and-white memory stirs...
translation: 一段红白两色的记忆悄然苏醒……

source: Is this your bookshop?
translation: 这是你的书店吗？

source: Very well. How may I assist you?
translation: 好的。有什么能为您效劳？
notes: 保留源文结尾 LF 换行。

source: Perhaps she is in mourning, yes.
translation: 也许她确实在服丧。

source: Perhaps, monsieur, it is best if you find somewhere else to sit.
translation: 先生，您或许最好另找个地方坐。

source: It intrigued me for years. The story shows up everywhere in different dress. A wolfhound in Wales. A pet bear in Spain. In Georgia, it's a panther...
translation: 多年来它一直让我着迷。这个故事换上不同外衣，到处出现。威尔士是一只猎狼犬，西班牙是一头宠物熊。到了格鲁吉亚，则是黑豹……

source: There's a door here, carefully painted, hinges almost flush with the wall. No handle, but all I need to do is tug at the other side -
translation: 这里有一扇门，漆得十分仔细，合页几乎与墙面齐平。没有把手，不过我只消从另一侧一拉——

source: I buried the heart. I have been waiting. Four hundred francisques for your trabai.
translation: 我把心脏埋了。我一直在等。你的特拉拜，四百弗朗西斯克。
notes: trabai 统一音译“特拉拜”；francisque 沿术语表。

source: A plaque reads: JÉREMIE - HAUTE-GARONNE - 1895
translation: 铭牌上写着：JÉREMIE——HAUTE-GARONNE——1895
notes: 专名与铭牌信息原样保留。

source: Table-pounding chortles from Aristide; a wicked giggle from Philomèle; an unexpectedly falsetto titter from Jean-Bernard. Even Leopold allows himself a thin smile.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德拍桌狂笑；菲洛梅勒坏心眼地咯咯笑；让-贝尔纳竟尖声窃笑起来。就连利奥波德也赏了我一丝薄笑。

source: I wonder where I'll wear it? A garden party? A cricket match? A desert conjuration?
translation: 不知道会穿它去什么地方？游园会？板球赛？沙漠里的召唤仪式？

source: There's a slightly discoloured rectangle on the wall behind the mirror. Was there a door here - now painted or plastered over?
translation: 镜子后方的墙上有一块略微变色的长方形。这里以前有扇门——后来被漆上或用灰泥封住了？

source: Fight.
translation: 反抗。
notes: 与后文 Submit 构成睡梦中的机制选项。

source: Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 以后再说吧。[暂且保留演化选项。]

source: Your word is enough for me, Doctor.
translation: 您的话对我来说就够了，医生。

source: A new twist for our little exile knot! My name is Rodia; welcome to this house.
translation: 我们这小小的流亡者之结，又有了新转折！我叫罗迪娅；欢迎来到这里。
notes: exile knot 保留“结”的反复意象。

source: Near one shelf in the corner of the shop, the crackling of the rain is less audible. Even my footsteps are softer. A sign on the shelf reads SILENCE.
translation: 店角那排书架旁，雨声也变得模糊。连我的脚步都轻了。架上有块牌子：静默。

source: Two passports. Neither qualifies me as a citizen of the French State. My British passport, in the name of Spencer Hobson, is valid, though the place of birth is false...
translation: 两本护照。哪一本都不能让我算作法兰西邦国公民。英国护照上的名字是斯宾塞·霍布森，证件仍然有效，只是出生地是假的……
notes: French State 依术语表译“法兰西邦国”。

source: Yes. I suggest you tell me the truth, Doctor.
translation: 是的。我建议您告诉我真相，医生。

source: "...and then she says, 'but why lamb?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说，‘可为什么偏偏是羊羔？’”[等待笑声]
notes: 保留源文末尾空格及笑声提示；按中文规范整理源文错乱的嵌套引号。

source: It is a pleasant enough dallying-place. I'll remain here until my translation to the Incorporate territories is arranged. I have important business in the West.
translation: 这是个还算惬意的盘桓之所。我会留在这里，等人安排我转往集团领地。我在西方有要事。

source: Pastis.
translation: 茴香酒。
notes: pastis 为法国茴香酒。

source: Pray, Mr Hobson, think no more of it. A gentleman understands that little better can be expected from the servant class.
translation: 得了，霍布森先生，别再放在心上。绅士自然明白，仆役阶级做事，也不能指望他们有多高明。
notes: 2026.8.j.46 增量：对照真实对话图、旧译与版本差异人工复核。

source: [This is a waste of time.]
translation: [这是浪费时间。]

source: [Back Out] Perhaps I'll just watch, for now.
translation: [退出] 也许我暂且看看就好。

source: A Greek name. I half-remember the word... rose? Pomegranate? Possibly?
translation: 一个希腊名字。我依稀记得这个词……玫瑰？石榴？也许？

source: [Shrug.]
translation: [耸肩。]

source: I stow the cigars carefully in my pockets to minimise the risk of crushing them.
translation: 我把雪茄小心收进衣袋，尽量避免压坏。

source: I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Hobson, that you must be mistaken. Dr Aubière is a man of excellent character.
translation: 很遗憾得告诉您，霍布森先生：一定是您弄错了。奥比耶医生品行端正，无可指摘。

source: I acknowledge your insight... disparage your tact. We'll agree that it is as you say.
translation: 我承认你的洞见……却鄙夷你的分寸。就当事情如你所说吧。

source: [Wink.]
translation: [眨眼。]

source: She's probably dead now.
translation: 她现在大概已经死了。

source: I could come back here later, if I need a shave.
translation: 以后需要刮胡子时，我可以再来这里。

source: Try to twist the dove.
translation: 试着扭动鸽子。

source: [Consider other options.]
translation: [考虑其他选项。]

source: I mean: everything good - everything, really - is supposed to emanate from the Oneness. It comes down to us from the henads, which participate in the Oneness, along their seirai. And at points along its descent, it manifests as distinct things we perceive. Like the Sun, or the phenomenal Hours.
translation: 我是说：一切善者——其实是一切——都被认为从太一流溢而出。它经由参与太一的诸一者，沿各自的序链降至我们这里。在下降途中的各个节点，它显现为我们感知到的不同事物。比如太阳，或现象界的司辰。
notes: Oneness / henads / seirai 统一译“太一／诸一者／神链”。 v1.2.5 术语终审：依最新版术语证据统一。

source: Welland was a Forge-[[long]] with military inclinations - a member of the Society of the Noble Endeavour who were often alchemists and generals, British royalists. What was he doing in Atlanta in 1865? And why does he feature in Aubière's dream?
translation: 韦兰是位醉心军旅的铸之[[long]]——高贵之举社团成员。该会多出炼金术士与将领，也拥护英国王室。他为何会在1865年的亚特兰大？又为何出现在奥比耶的梦中？
notes: 保留 [[long]] 链接；Society of the Noble Endeavour；开放终审：服从前作官中或逐词证据链，修正设定称谓。；开放终审：按新发现的固定词形统一。

source: You're a Mansus-spirit. And not a well one, or you wouldn't choose to be here in the Sanitarium.
translation: 你是漫宿的灵体。而且状况不佳，否则不会选择待在疗养院里。

source: That door! I must get my eyes examined.
translation: 那扇门！我真该去检查眼睛。

source: [Look him in the eye and wait.]
translation: [直视他的眼睛，等下去。]

source: Come on, don't swallow that from him. Time to go, [q=alias.formal].
translation: 得了，别听他那一套。该走了，[q=alias.formal]。
notes: 完整保留查询变量与斜体标签。

source: If that's all you have...
translation: 如果你只有这些……

source: Don't lecture me. You small-minded man. Don't lecture me. You know nothing of a woman's pain.
translation: 别教训我。你这个心胸狭窄的男人。别教训我。你根本不懂女人的痛苦。

source: [TEST] Straight to Sanitarium
translation: [测试] 直达疗养院
notes: 保留开发标记 [TEST]。

source: A well-used Rosières gas cooker in chipped cream enamel.
translation: 一台用得很旧的罗西耶尔燃气灶，奶油色搪瓷已斑驳剥落。
notes: Rosières 为法国厨具品牌。

source: Coffee, please. Black.
translation: 请来杯咖啡。黑咖啡。

source: Something undefined about the shapes. Are they moving? Drifting? They never quite resolve. An acrid odour wafts from the water.
translation: 这些形状有某种说不清的异样。它们在动吗？在漂移？始终无法完全成形。一股刺鼻气味从水面飘来。

source: I'll cut a dash.
translation: 我一定很惹眼。
notes: cut a dash 指衣着显眼、气派，结合风衣语境意译。

source: And what?
translation: 还有什么？

source: Still, there is grey in my hair now. In my time outside, neither time nor pain forgot me.
translation: 不过，我的头发如今也夹了灰白。在外面的那些岁月里，时间和痛苦都没有忘记我。

source: Eccentric painter's technique, probably.
translation: 多半只是画家的怪异技法。

source: Aubière conceals his passions, but cannot suppress them. This panel fairly vibrates with the strength of his ambition.
translation: 奥比耶把激情藏得很好，却压不住它们。这块嵌板几乎被他的野心震得发颤。

source: What is she to you, Hobson?
translation: 她和你是什么关系，霍布森？

source: In other words, we have passed a point of no return. We cannot know what has happened to our world. To discuss the matter will only expand our ignorance - until we grope like apes in the dark.
translation: 换言之，我们已经越过不归点。我们无从知道自己的世界发生了什么。此事越谈，未知反而越多——最终，我们只能像猿猴一样在黑暗中摸索。
notes: 改去“扩大我们的无知”的英语搭配，保留莱奥波德悲观而学究的语气。

source: [Back away.]
translation: [退开。]

source: A controversial passage in... I forget whether it was the Received or Sanctioned Version, and the binding is plain, without clues.
translation: 一段有争议的篇章，出自……我忘了是通行版还是核准版；装帧朴素，看不出线索。
notes: 沿用《司辰之书》既有定名“通行版／核准版”。

source: M. Hobson...
translation: 霍布森先生……

source: [Look out across the sea. It's a beautiful day. Nothing like the drab town streets.]
translation: [眺望大海。天气晴美，与灰暗街道判若两地。]

source: Times are tight. I really can't spare the cash.
translation: 手头紧，实在拿不出这笔钱。

source: Good heavens, M. Hobson, then you can leave, of course, at any time! I would in any case find it very difficult to restrict your movements.
translation: 天哪，霍布森先生，那您当然随时都可以离开！不管怎样，要限制您的行动对我来说也很困难。

source: Good. Good.
translation: 很好。很好。

source: You're sitting very close to those... holes.
translation: 你坐得离那些……洞，太近了。

source: You know Reinhardt, but you don't know 'Nuages'?
translation: 你知道莱因哈特，却不知道《云》？
notes: Nuages 为姜戈·莱因哈特名曲，通译《云》。

source: I can imagine.
translation: 可以想见。

source: It is no laughing matter, Mr Hobson, this evolution of mine. No laughing matter at all.
translation: 这场演变绝非什么笑料，霍布森先生。一点也不好笑。
notes: 2026.8.j.46 增量：对照真实对话图、旧译与版本差异人工复核。

source: Linou said that, did she?
translation: 莉努这么说的，是吗？

source: Examine the cigars more closely.
translation: 再仔细看看雪茄。

source: She came, she stayed, she left. I think she got what she wanted.
translation: 她来了，住下，又走了。我想她得到了想要的。

source: [Flags. Everyone gets so excited about flags.]
translation: [旗帜。人人都为旗帜激动得不得了。]

source: What's in it?
translation: 里面有什么？

source: Where?
translation: 哪儿？

source: Apparently, the matter of my papers has been forgotten.
translation: 看来，他们已经忘了查我的证件。

source: Wait... Lagasse. She is a widow?
translation: 等等……拉格斯。她是寡妇？

source: I know her a little. We used to see each other at church. I felt sorry for her. But she never really approved of me anyway. And I don't think she likes people feeling sorry for her.
translation: 我和她有几分交情，从前常在教堂碰见。我可怜她。可她一向不怎么赞同我的为人——再说，我想她也不爱被人可怜。

source: Nina was sunset. [Bessy shakes her head in admiration.]
translation: 宁娜是落日。[贝茜钦佩地摇摇头。]
notes: sunset 疑为 Bessy 的私用比喻或俚语，保留落日意象。

source: The Sheaf, from today. An excellent State paper.
translation: 今天的《禾捆》。一份出色的邦国报纸。
notes: The Sheaf 为报刊名，开放终审采用《禾捆》；State 依术语表译“邦国”；完整保留两组富文本标签。

source: The clock whirrs and whines. The numbers flip frantically to what might be a date or a message, before returning to the steady flipping. The mechanism is incomprehensible.
translation: 时钟嗡嗡转动，发出尖细声响。数字疯狂翻转，变成似乎是日期或讯息的排列，随后又恢复稳定翻页。这机关究竟怎么运作，完全看不明白。
notes: 将 mechanism 按眼前机械装置译“机关”，避免生硬的“机理无法理解”。

source: Did we win basic enthusiasm from Aub?
translation: 我们让奥比耶对我们产生基础热情了吗？
notes: 开发测试文本；Aub 为 Aubière 的简称。

source: [Lift the glass of pastis that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起莉努给我添在托盘上的那杯茴香酒。]

source: Acceptable, I suppose. Was there anything else?
translation: 勉强可以吧。还有别的事吗？

source: A droning tone, like a sermonious and didactic bee, drags me from muddled dreams. My alarm has woken me.
translation: 一声单调的嗡鸣把我拖出乱梦，活像只爱布道、好说教的蜜蜂。闹钟响了。
notes: 保留 sermonious 的滑稽造词感。

source: [An ear flicks lazily.]
translation: [一只耳朵懒洋洋地动了动。]

source: [Dread 7+] lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
translation: [Dread 7+] lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
notes: k.83 开发占位条目（Dread 条件为未实装机制），恒等保留。

source: The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening. When they look back, they'll think of this moment as the hinge, the last bright beat before a silence.
translation: 狂热消退，飞蛾离席——但席间众人永远都会记得，这一夜仿佛中了魔。日后回首，他们会把此刻视作枢轴：沉寂之前，最后一次明亮的搏动。
notes: 明确 they 指席间众人，避免就近误指飞蛾。

source: Spencer, right? I'm Bessy. What's shaking?
translation: 斯宾塞，对吧？我是贝茜。最近怎么样？
notes: What's shaking 依 Bessy 口吻作口语意译。

source: [Run on, slowing now.]
translation: [继续跑，速度渐渐慢下来。]

source: A cheering rush of hot water! I remembered to put the plug in, just in time.
translation: 热水欢腾着涌出！我及时记得塞上塞子。

source: [Sinombre's light pulses softly.]
translation: [西农布尔的光柔和地脉动。]

source: [Put as much distance between me and the Milice place as quickly as possible.]
translation: [尽快远离民兵团驻地。]
notes: Milice 统一译“民团”。；润色2026-08-18：Milice 统一为“民兵团”

source: [Renew diplomatic ties.]
translation: [重建外交关系。]

source: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

source: 'A few days.' How long, exactly?
translation: “几天。”确切说是多久？

source: 'Good evening, Jeremy.'
translation: “晚上好，杰里米。”

source: Ha, okay. Funny thing? That's how I felt about coming here.
translation: 哈，好吧。说来也怪，我来这里时也是这种感觉。
notes: Funny thing? 在此引出巧合，并非实际提问。

source: The blond man is watching me impatiently.
translation: 金发男人不耐烦地盯着我。

source: I thank you for the admiration, [q=alias.formal.fr].
translation: 感谢您的赞赏，[q=alias.formal.fr]。
notes: 保留查询变量。

source: Let's discuss... quieter business.
translation: 我们谈谈……清静生意。
notes: 润色2026-08-18：quieter business 作为固定反讽短语统一为“清静生意”（chunk_001/002/004 既定）

source: Vincent. How's the leg?
translation: 文森特。腿怎么样？

source: [Store that one away.]
translation: [把这件事记下。]

source: Lagasse. You have a description?
translation: 拉格斯。你有她的特征吗？

source: The things in Russia, I mean. The ones behind the Ministries. Everything changed when they came. I was an [[Icarian]]. I still am, I suppose. I think it might get better. But I think, before then, it will get much worse.
translation: 我是说俄国的那些东西。藏在部委背后的那些。它们一来，一切都变了。我曾是[[Icarian]]。现在大概也还是。我想事情终会好转；可在那之前，只怕要坏上许多。
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: [Back.]
translation: [返回。]

source: A patriot first, then everything besides. Against the [[Enemy]], we had no help - except, that is, the Stars and [[Ministries]]. Our idiot King had fled, but now he thinks the throne is his to claim again, with British help -
translation: 先是爱国者，才是其他一切。我们对抗[[Enemy]]时，无人施援——除了群星和[[Ministries]]。我们的蠢国王逃之夭夭；如今倒以为凭英国人相助，就能回来讨还王位——
notes: 保留两处链接目标。

source: Give Andrée my compliments. Perhaps she can help you find your friend.
translation: 请代我向安德蕾问好。也许她能帮你找到朋友。

source: Sod that for a game of soldiers.
translation: 去他的，老子不干了。
notes: Sod that for a game of soldiers 为英国口语拒绝语，按主角降调语气意译。

source: What do you have here?
translation: 你这儿有什么？

source: "My heart is not my own." I've heard that phrase. But, pilgrim, you mean something different, yes? I thank you.
translation: “我的心不属于我。”这句话我听过。不过，朝圣者，你说的另有一层意思，是吗？多谢。

source: I suppose I will, won't -
translation: 我想我会的，对不——
notes: won't I 的反意问句在说完前被打断。

source: You're... American?
translation: 你是……美国人？

source: Yes. Wiser not to discuss her, even during daylight. And especially not to mention her name.
translation: 是的。即使白天也最好别谈她。尤其别提她的名字。

source: [Lift the glass of white wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起莉努给我添在托盘上的那杯白葡萄酒。]

source: The cat in the living room.
translation: 客厅里的猫。

source: Léon cries out in exultation, but already he's panting. Hobbled as I am, I'm still faster.
translation: 莱昂欣喜地叫喊，但已经气喘吁吁。我虽然跛着，还是更快。

source: [I added something to Philomèle's drink. Watch and wait to see any effect.]
translation: [我在菲洛梅勒的酒里加了点东西。观察并等待效果。]

source: The garments I recovered from Janvier the tailor, that I'd given him to mend, long ago...
translation: 很久以前，我交给裁缝让维耶修补、后来又取回的那些衣服……

source: [Possessed] Even before I went away, first time in a new city was always exciting.
translation: [着魔] 即使在我离开以前，初到一座新城市也总让人兴奋。
notes: Possessed 在 acquirePotentialPassion 机制中指已经持有该激情，开放终审采用“已有”，避免误作附身。；润色2026-08-18：状态标签 [Possessed] 统一为“着魔”；“已有”系误读

source: It might not matter.
translation: 也许无关紧要。

source: If I step through the hidden door here, I'll be in Aubière's secret office, or secret lumber room.
translation: 从这扇暗门穿过去，便是奥比耶的秘密办公室——也可能只是秘密杂物间。

source: Hmf. After so many years I should really have learnt not to fritter my insights away.
translation: 哼。过了这么多年，我真该学会别再白白浪费洞见。

source: [Shrug; wink.]
translation: [耸肩；眨眼。]

source: I thought they'd pulped every copy...
translation: 我还以为他们把每一本都打成纸浆了……

source: Who is, my friend? Who is? But, listen, [q=alias.last], I prefer this one: 'A glass in the nose, and the tongue loosens.'
translation: 朋友，谁不是呢？谁不是呢？不过听着，[q=alias.last]，我更喜欢这一句：“酒杯凑到鼻下，舌头便松了。”
notes: 保留查询变量。

source: Me, also.
translation: 我也是。

source: Really just a social call, Mr Strathcoyne. But if I might impose on you to answer a few questions -
translation: 其实只是来叙叙旧，斯特拉思科因先生。不过若能劳您回答几个问题——

source: Absolutely!
translation: 当然！

source: Not the world entire. But what has occurred. Perhaps you have noticed, [q=alias.familiar], that the world is different since the war.
translation: 不是整个世界。而是发生过的事。也许你已经注意到，[q=alias.familiar]，战后的世界不一样了。
notes: 保留查询变量。

source: [Leave the matter for now.]
translation: [暂且放下此事。]

source: A sleek Swedish Electrolux model. Lux indeed. There can't be many of these in Antibes. It's out of place in the humble kitchen. How did the proprietress afford it?
translation: 一台线条流畅的瑞典伊莱克斯。名副其实的“Lux”（拉丁语“光”）。昂蒂布不可能有多少台。摆在这间朴素厨房里很不相称。女店主怎么置办得起？
notes: 保留 Electrolux 中 Lux 的英文双关。；v2.3.2 Lux 双关补注

source: She wanted you to do what?
translation: 她要你做什么？

source: Resident... for now.
translation: 住客……暂时是。

source: [Pay one thousand francisques, let Vincent go third class] I'll see you in Mimata.
translation: [支付一千弗朗西斯克，让文森特乘三等座] 米马塔见。
notes: francisque 开放终审采用“弗朗西斯克”。

source: I'm by the wall at the back of Aubière's office.
translation: 我就在奥比耶办公室后墙边。

source: Well.
translation: 哦。

source: Fortunately, in my line of work, it pays to show an interest in the comings and goings of strangers.
translation: 幸好，做我这行，留意陌生人的来来往往总有好处。

source: Saints collect patrocinia in much the same way that...
translation: 圣人收罗各式庇佑名目，就像……
notes: patrocinia 为 patrocinium 的复数，指圣徒所辖的庇佑／主保范围；按喜鹊收集小玩意的比喻意译，并保留原文强调标签。

source: Order a coffee, then.
translation: 那就点杯咖啡。

source: Doctor to the stars, perhaps. Or a spiritual instructor to politicians and princesses. But there'd always have been something missing.
translation: 或许会给名流看病，或给政客与公主当精神导师。但心里总会缺上一块。

source: Perhaps. If I remember this. It's really a dream?
translation: 也许吧。只要我记得。这真是梦？

source: What did you have in mind?
translation: 你有什么打算？

source: So I see.
translation: 看出来了。

source: I wish you every chance. But Nina's gone. I liked her, but I never trusted her. So smooth; so bright; so sharp. I don't know what she sought, here in Antibes. She said once that the sun sets here; but yet I do not think she liked to watch it set.
translation: 祝你好运。但宁娜已经走了。我喜欢她，却从没信过她。太圆滑，太明亮，太锋利。我不知道她来昂蒂布寻什么。她有次说，太阳在这里落下；可我想，她其实并不爱看日落。

source: Look through the financial records.
translation: 查看财务记录。

source: There's a rather grim scholarly debate on whether the Cross-changed actually become the end product, or are consumed by the Cross-seed within them. Strathcoyne's arm moves with unsettling independence.
translation: 学界有一场颇为阴森的争论：经介壳种之变的人，究竟真的成了那最终的产物，还是反被体内的介壳种之种吞噬？斯特拉思科因的手臂自行其是，令人不安。
notes: Cross-change / Cross-seed 依术语表统一为“介壳种之变／介壳种之种”。

source: When I've convinced Nina to help me... then I can leave.
translation: 等我说服宁娜帮我……就能离开。

source: [You're following your Curiosity wherever it might lead. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: [你正追随好奇心，无论它将你引往何处。虽说人是会变的。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。]

source: Then I curse you! I curse your name and your shadow! Leave me alone! Never return!
translation: 那我诅咒你！诅咒你的名字和影子！别管我！永远别回来！

source: The aristocracy of the old Sun; a power of the Mansus gracing the Wake. [Incline your head.]
translation: 古老太阳的贵族；一股为醒时增辉的漫宿伟力。[颔首。]

source: Good afternoon. You are looking for something?
translation: 下午好。您在找什么吗？

source: That is all. If there is a deeper design, it is hidden from me also. You have my word on it.
translation: 仅此而已。若有更深图谋，我也看不见。我向你保证。

source: At last... it's time to get out.
translation: 终于……该出去了。

source: [He smiles, tentatively at first, and then with a rush of surprising warmth.]
translation: [他笑起来，起初还有几分迟疑，随即忽然变得出人意料地温暖。]

source: A minute. Two minutes. Three, and I can smell smoke. Four, five... and I hear shouts of alarm. A bell begins to clang. Someone's staggering to the waiting room, holding a bucket of sand. The poinçonneuse, delighted by the excitement, hurries from her post to help.
translation: 一分钟。两分钟。三分钟，我闻到了烟味。四、五……又听见惊叫。铃开始铛铛作响。有人提着一桶沙，跌跌撞撞地赶往候车室。女检票员被这场骚动弄得兴奋不已，也匆匆离岗去帮忙。
notes: poinçonneuse 依车站语境译“女检票员”，与同批其他用例统一；保留斜体。

source: Didn't the painting come from Hush House?
translation: 那幅画不是来自噤声居屋吗？

source: Yes, of course she needs to let Vincent through too, he's carrying the luggage. I'm his Grace's private secretary, not a valet! I don't carry luggage.
translation: 对，她当然也得让文森特过去，他提着行李。我是阁下的私人秘书，不是男仆！我不提行李。

source: Philomèle, laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose. Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. And me, watching.
translation: 菲洛梅勒伏在让-贝尔纳肩头笑，头发渐渐散开。阿里斯蒂德检查烟斗钵里有没有告密者。利奥波德入迷地看着飞蛾扑进来啜饮他的酒。让-贝尔纳执拗地在蜡烛侧面刻下一首四行诗。而我在旁看着。

source: I apologise, [q=alias.formal], for these savages. If they had better manners, they'd introduce themselves.
translation: [q=alias.formal]，请原谅这帮野人。他们若懂半点礼数，早该自报家门了。
notes: 保留查询变量。

source: Lie down for a few minutes.
translation: 躺下几分钟。

source: We've never met. But she has information I need.
translation: 我们从未见过。但她掌握我需要的信息。

source: Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. Fortunately for him, I was unmoved by the temptation to petty theft.
translation: 斯特拉思科因珍藏的昂贵雪茄。算他走运，我没有屈从于小偷小摸的诱惑。

source: ...perhaps, after all, you're right. Very well.
translation: ……也许你说得对。好吧。

source: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum.'
translation: [司辰学]“他无法静止；他索求舞蹈；他被敲击，如同一面鼓。”
notes: HOROMACHISTRY 是玩家可见的对话技艺提示，与其他同场条目统一译“司辰学”。

source: THIS has been the Travelling at Night demo.
translation: 这便是《夜游漫记》试玩版。
notes: 沿术语表译作品名；保留斜体标签与末尾空格。

source: I've been away from Europe almost all that time. I didn't know you'd recorded anything else.
translation: 这期间我几乎一直不在欧洲。我不知道你还录过别的东西。

source: Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted his Pierrots, here by the sea.
translation: 昂蒂布。战争降临世界之前，这里曾是蔚蓝海岸甜美的蓝眼睛。游艇、宴会、电影明星的别墅。毕加索曾在这片海边画下他的丑角。
notes: 保留源文末尾空格。

source: And I'm here, as I promised. I can't take your hand. Sinombre has passed beyond flesh. But now turn to my light and consider my voice, and we'll see what will open to you...
translation: 我也依约来到这里。我无法握住你的手。西农布尔已经越过血肉。但现在，转向我的光，思量我的声音，我们来看看会有什么向你开启……

source: Thank you, M. Hobson. I could in all candour ask for nothing more. Except... euh... perhaps my box. May I please have my box back?
translation: 谢谢您，霍布森先生。坦白说，我别无所求。只是……呃……也许还有我的盒子。能请您把盒子还给我吗？

source: I will know who you are, and what you're doing here.
translation: 我会弄清你是谁，又来这里做什么。

source: Spencer's an English name. You're far from home.
translation: 斯宾塞是个英国名字。你离家很远。

source: I don't think so.
translation: 我想不是。

source: Do you ever make use of the black market, Doctor?
translation: 医生，您用过黑市吗？

source: [Perhaps I could find a way to travel without a ticket.]
translation: [也许我能找到无票旅行的方法。]

source: A wiry, handsome man loiters by the entrance, whistling jauntily.
translation: 一个精瘦英俊的男人在入口处闲荡，轻快地吹着口哨。
notes: 2026.8.j.46 增量：对照真实对话图、旧译与版本差异人工复核。

source: [[Nina Lagasse]] was seen entering the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation: 有人看见[[Nina Lagasse]]走进“今日”疗养院。就在昂蒂布角，过了公园不远。
notes: 保留链接目标；Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿前批开放终审采用“今日”疗养院。

source: ...no, thank you.
translation: ……不，谢谢。

source: And that, Guinefort, is why before you risk any good deeds, you always make sure you know who'll get the credit.
translation: 所以说，吉内福尔，冒险行善之前，总得先弄清功劳会落到谁头上。
notes: Guinefort 沿前批译“吉内福尔”。

source: Open it.
translation: 打开它。

source: [Potential] That was never going to last.
translation: [潜在] 那本就不可能长久。
notes: Potential 沿前批译“潜在”。

source: [Any number of binding oaths suggest themselves. There are ways to be safe.]
translation: [诸般束缚誓言自会浮上心头。总有办法确保安全。]

source: 'The Pilgrim Rose.
translation: “《朝圣者玫瑰》。”
notes: k.83 改为斜体格式（原文无右单引号）；译文整体斜体保留旧标点。

source: [The calendrier should tell me where Nina is. I'll look in my inventory.]
translation: [日程表应该会告诉我宁娜在哪里。我去物品栏里看看。]
notes: calendrier 沿前批译“日程表”。

source: The books in the graveyard are for display only. Not for sale.
translation: 墓园里的书只供陈列，概不出售。

source: [Mathis' eyes flash with anger. But he says nothing.]
translation: [马蒂斯眼中怒火一闪。但他什么也没说。]

source: I remember you!
translation: 我记得你！

source: Janvier's old premises in Paris, he said. The last summer he was there.
translation: 他说，那是让维耶在巴黎的旧址。也是他在那里度过最后一个夏天的地方。
notes: premises 按商号旧址处理。

source: Step through.
translation: 跨过去。

source: [Sip cautiously.]
translation: [小心地抿一口。]

source: Oh yes. Always yes.
translation: 哦，是的。永远都是。

source: Through the door into a concrete corridor lined with ratty carpet and lit by a single bulb. Far off, an electric bell rings twice.
translation: 穿过门，是一条混凝土走廊，铺着破旧的地毯，只有一只灯泡照明。远处，电铃响了两声。

source: For someone. A woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 找一个人。一位女士，[[Nina Lagasse]]。
notes: 避免“一个女人”的逐词直译；保留回答的断句感和链接目标。

source: If I bring you this kind of information... will you help me find [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: 如果我把这类情报带给你……你会帮我找到[[Nina Lagasse]]吗？
notes: 保留链接目标及源文尾随空格。

source: A house of tolerance, indeed!
translation: 好一个“宽容之家”！
notes: house of tolerance 双关法国旧称 maison de tolérance（妓院），正文保留反讽字面。

source: Sharp, quartzy . As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation: 尖锐，带着石英般的质感。我再次放下小罐时，幻光的闪烁模糊了我的视野。
notes: 源文 Sharp, quartzy 后有异常空格和句点，按连贯句意整理。

source: [You can now don the Honneur et Humanité outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣柜处换上“荣誉与人道”套装。]
notes: 服装名与同名条目《荣誉与人道》统一；界面提示用引号而非书名号。

source: All right. Well... the Church teaches that the Sun is one element of a procession along the seira from the henad. [Get into the theology of it.]
translation: 好吧。那么……教会教导我们，太阳是自一者沿序链流溢而下的序列之一环。[深入解释相关神学。]
notes: seira / henad 统一译“神链／一元体”；procession 按新柏拉图主义语境译出流溢次序。 v1.2.5 术语终审：依最新版术语证据统一。

source: Gasps of pleased surprise from the tables behind me.
translation: 身后桌边传来惊喜的抽气声。

source: It's been years.
translation: 都这么多年了。
notes: 保留富文本标签。

source: Vincent.
translation: 文森特。

source: ...something else?
translation: ……还有别的吗？

source: As I said: my utmost gratitude. Thank you, madame. Heaven lift you!
translation: 还是那句话：感激不尽。多谢，夫人。愿上天托举您！

source: [Possessed] But Picasso - Picasso had an owl.
translation: [着魔] 可毕加索——毕加索有一只猫头鹰。
notes: Possessed 沿本批机制语境译“已有”；保留嵌套富文本标签。；润色2026-08-18：[Possessed]→着魔

source: [Menace] There are worse dreams you might experience, Doctor. Much, much worse dreams.
translation: [威胁] 你还可能做更糟的梦，医生。糟得多，糟得多。
notes: Menace 沿前批译“威胁”。

source: A dream about where Nina's gone.
translation: 一场有关宁娜去向的梦。

source: But I don't want anything. It's the saint. She can't see; and at last here you are, to help her.
translation: 可我什么都不想要。是那位圣人。她看不见；而你终于来了，来帮助她。

source: I never mix business with politics. A rule of long standing. Very useful, this last decade. Now: shall we do business?
translation: 我从不让生意和政治搅在一起。一条守了多年的规矩。过去这十年格外管用。现在：我们做生意吗？

source: My husband is gone. Find him for me.
translation: 我丈夫不见了。替我找到他。

source: Nothing.
translation: 什么也没有。

source: Beeswax. Odd thing to put on a shelf.
translation: 蜂蜡。这东西搁在架子上倒奇怪。

source: Acute advice, monsieur. I shall stow it beneath my heart.
translation: 高见，先生。我会将它珍藏心底。
notes: stow it beneath my heart 保留略带古意的客套语气。

source: The old woman who masquerades as the Pilgrim's mother. Her attributes strongly suggest the [[Vagabond]].
translation: 那个冒充朝圣者母亲的老妇人。她的种种性相强烈暗示，她就是[[Vagabond]]。
notes: 保留链接目标；attributes 按本作设定译“性相”。

source: Examine the box for inscriptions.
translation: 检查盒子上有无铭文。

source: Down, into the place beneath night and heart.
translation: 向下，进入夜与心之下的所在。

source: Blue garments, starry sea.
translation: 蓝衣，星海。
notes: 保持图像式短句。

source: Coca-Cola.
translation: 可口可乐。
notes: 品牌采用通行中文名，与前批一致。

source: The priest blinks slowly, as if struggling to focus.
translation: 神父缓缓眨眼，仿佛难以将视线聚焦。

source: However...
translation: 不过……

source: [Consider the nature of curses.]
translation: [思考诅咒的本质。]

source: testTravelTag multiplier check
translation: testTravelTag multiplier check
notes: 内部测试字符串，依要求原样保留。

source: Wad the papers into a ball, touch the lighter to the ball, stuff it halfway down the side of the cushion.
translation: 把纸揉成一团，用打火机点着，再把火团塞进坐垫侧边，只留一半在外。

source: [Potential] And now here I am! Even before I went away, first time in a new city was always exciting.
translation: [潜在] 而我如今到了这里！就算在我离开以前，初到一座新城市也总让人兴奋。
notes: Potential 沿前批译“潜在”。

source: But I have to find [[Nina Lagasse]]... and her trail has brought me here.
translation: 但我必须找到[[Nina Lagasse]]……她留下的踪迹把我引到了这里。
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: Closing the conversation and opening the travel map.
translation: 结束对话并打开旅行地图。
notes: 内部流程测试文本；travel map 按界面功能译“旅行地图”。

source: Not exactly beeswax. The texture is wrong. The scent is too sharp. A mottled pattern beneath the surface shifts with the light. It might be one of the exudations of the [[Carapace Cross]].
translation: 不全是蜂蜡。质地不对，气味也太冲。表层之下有斑驳纹路，随光游移。或许是[[Carapace Cross]]的某种分泌物。
notes: 保留链接目标；exudations 按生物性语境译“分泌物”。

source: Fading to black, then leaving for the map. This is the zone-exit-style sequence the audit recommended as supplementary smoke coverage for B5 and B6.
translation: 淡出至黑屏，随后离开并前往地图。这是审计建议用作 B5 和 B6 补充冒烟测试的区域退出式序列。
notes: 内部测试文本；保留 B5、B6 技术标识。

source: Vapour softens the air, fogs the window-glass, beads greedily on the tiling.
translation: 水汽把空气蒸软，蒙住窗玻璃，又贪婪地攀上瓷砖，凝作水珠。

source: [What does it remind me of?]
translation: [它让我想起了什么？]

source: [Lie] She's an old friend. I heard she'd come here, to Antibes.
translation: [撒谎] 她是我的一位老朋友。我听说她来了昂蒂布。
notes: Lie 沿前批译“撒谎”。

source: Really?
translation: 当真？

source: A difficult term to define, where the [[Cross]]-nature manifests. Perhaps better to say that he will advance.
translation: 这个词不好界定，用来指[[Cross]]之性显现。或许更准确的说法是：他将再进一步。
notes: 保留链接目标；advance 所指的介壳种变化阶段尚不明确，保留含混。

source: Oh, that door!
translation: 哦，是那扇门！
notes: 保留富文本标签。

source: Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. I've already pilfered a few.
translation: 斯特拉思科因珍藏的昂贵雪茄。我已经顺走了几根。
notes: Strathcoyne 统一为“斯特拉思科因”。

source: Goodbye for now, M. Hobson. I hope you will speak to our other guests... I am interested to learn what you all make of each other.
translation: 暂且再会，霍布森先生。我希望您会同其他客人谈谈……我很想知道你们如何看待彼此。

source: Perhaps he's weeping. With the rain, it's difficult to be sure.
translation: 也许他在哭。雨声雨幕之中，很难确定。

source: Look around -
translation: 四下看看——

source: [Truth] There's a matter that only Nina can help with.
translation: [实话] 有一件事，只有宁娜能帮上忙。
notes: 与前批相同原句保持一致。

source: [Read resonantly from the Book: let my voice echo.]
translation: [朗声诵读书中文字：让我的声音回荡。]

source: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

source: Only bad in bad weather. So I stay on this side of the park, hey?
translation: 也就天气坏的时候难走。所以我待在公园这边，明白吧？
notes: 结合上下文将 bad 理解为道路／行程不便。

source: In Fucine, 'the dry tongue', that symbol means...
translation: 在被称作“枯舌”的富奇诺语中，这个符号意为……
notes: dry tongue 直译“枯舌”，与另处 witch tongue 的别称区分；以定语消化英文同位语。

source: Neither does the Milice serve as an office of information.
translation: 民兵团也不是情报处。
notes: Milice 统一译“民团”。；润色2026-08-18：Milice 统一

source: [Reply frivolously.]
translation: [轻佻作答。]

source: What's next?
translation: 接下来呢？

source: Don't get in my way.
translation: 别碍我的事。

source: [Steer the conversation back to other matters.]
translation: [把话题引回其他事情。]

source: Léon shakes his head vaguely. He tilts his head as if he can hear martial music. Above, the flag snaps in the rising wind.
translation: 莱昂茫然地摇摇头。他歪着脑袋，仿佛听见了军乐。头顶，旗帜在渐起的风中猎猎作响。

source: Where's [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: [[Nina Lagasse]]在哪儿？
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: [Optimistic interpretation] 'Here is the revelation of roses.'
translation: [乐观的解读] “玫瑰的启示在此。”
notes: 与阴郁／中性解读的同组句式保持对应。

source: Of course not.
translation: 当然不是。

source: [Read other news.]
translation: [读读其他新闻。]

source: [Turn and leave without a word.]
translation: [转身一言不发地离开。]

source: I swear that I'll guide you; nor draw from your strength; nor enter where I am not bid. On the [[Watchman]] I swear it, the Door in the Eye, on his robe and his [[Names]] and his light.
translation: 我发誓会引领你；不汲取你的力量；不踏入未受邀之地。我以[[Watchman]]起誓——以瞳中之扉，以他的长袍、[[Names]]与光起誓。
notes: 保留两个双中括号链接；维持誓言的三段排比与庄严语气。 v1.2.5 术语终审：依最新版术语证据统一。

source: And then she's lost in her thoughts, lips moving slightly.
translation: 随后她陷入沉思，嘴唇微微翕动。

source: I don't like her records. And one is never certain, with a Greek.
translation: 我不喜欢她的档案。何况，是希腊人，总叫人拿不准。
notes: 保留人物带偏见的原话，不替叙述背书。

source: She knew me. Yes.
translation: 她认识我。是的。

source: [Nod and leave.]
translation: [点头离开。]

source: My secret is out, hein? The little follies of youth.
translation: 我的秘密暴露了，嗯？年轻时的一点荒唐事。
notes: k.83 给 hein 加斜体强调。

source: I suppose I can hardly prevent you...
translation: 我想我是怎么也阻止不了你……

source: [Cast the sea-water on the brazier before the window.]
translation: [将海水泼向窗前的火盆。]

source: (The man has sea-urchins in his pockets.)
translation: （这男人口袋里装着海胆。）
notes: 保留圆括号结构。

source: The world divides; the saint unites. I am to tell you that [[Nina Lagasse]] entered the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 世界使万物分离；圣人令万物合一。她要我告诉你，[[Nina Lagasse]]进了“今日”疗养院。
notes: 保留链接目标；Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿前批开放终审采用“今日”疗养院。

source: No. This is none of my business.
translation: 不。这与我无关。

source: Oh...yes. [Aubière glances, startled, at the image in the Wood.]
translation: 哦……对。[奥比耶吃惊地瞥向林地中的影像。]
notes: Wood 依术语表译“林地”。

source: Thankfully, the State bears the burden of the war in the former colonial possessions of poor lost France. Ergo, the victories continue.
translation: 幸而，在可怜的亡国法兰西昔日的殖民属地，战争重担由邦国承担。所以，捷报不断。
notes: poor lost France 指已经失落的法兰西，former 修饰 colonial possessions；State 作为架空政治实体开放终审采用“邦国”，前批亦有“国家”用例，已完成开放终审。

source: Black cashmere polo-neck, black notched bag trousers, black suede loafers. A statement. And the statement is:
translation: 黑色羊绒高领衫，黑色缺口宽腿裤，黑色麂皮乐福鞋。一份宣言。而宣言是：
notes: notched bag trousers 为年代服装用语，开放终审采用“缺口宽腿裤”。

source: The world, I grant you, has changed. More things are possible that once were not.
translation: 我承认，世界变了。许多从前不可能的事，如今已经有了可能。

source: [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: [[Nina Lagasse]]。
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: You've found my graveyard.
translation: 你找到我的墓园了。

source: It took me too long to realise what balls it all was.
translation: 我花了太久，才明白这一切纯属胡扯。
notes: balls 按英式口语译“胡扯”。

source: I have already made my feelings very clear on that... icy villainess.
translation: 我已经把自己对那个……冰冷女恶棍的看法说得很清楚了。

source: Rodia. I'm Spencer.
translation: 罗迪娅。我叫斯宾塞。

source: I'm expected.
translation: 有人在等我。

source: Vincent. Can I ask you some questions?
translation: 文森特。我能问你几个问题吗？

source: I promise nothing.
translation: 我不作任何承诺。

source: You are wise to be wary, my guttering light. But Sinombre is not what she was. Come closer, come closer, look into the scrine... and Sinombre will give you her light.
translation: 你小心提防是明智的，我那摇曳的微光。但西农布尔已非昔日。靠近些，靠近些，望进灵龛……西农布尔会把她的光赐给你。
notes: 终审：scrine 定名“灵龛”；保留重复召唤节奏。

source: [Nod. Pull a coin out of Strathcoyne's ear and offer it to him.]
translation: [点头。从斯特拉思科因耳后变出一枚硬币，递给他。]
notes: pull a coin out of one's ear 按魔术动作处理。

source: Saint Reparata said I would have a visitor. Is it you?
translation: 圣雷帕拉塔说会有一位访客来找我。是你吗？
notes: Saint Reparata 沿前批译“圣雷帕拉塔”。

source: To learn more, examine the Calendrier in your Inventory.
translation: 若想了解更多，请查看物品栏中的日程表。
notes: Calendrier 沿前批译“日程表”；Inventory 作为界面名译“物品栏”。

source: Arrange a diversion. Someone here might have history with the poinçonneuse - an enemy, or a friend.
translation: 安排一场调虎离山。这里或许有人同那位女检票员有旧——仇人，或朋友。
notes: 保留富文本标签；poinçonneuse 为法语女性检票员／打孔员，结合车站场景译“女检票员”。

source: A hidden door! Not locked in any way that might matter.
translation: 一扇暗门！没用任何真正管用的方式上锁。

source: A dove. There is an Hour named Elegiast. The Ivory Dove, he's called.
translation: 一只鸽子。有一位司辰名为悼歌诗人。人称骨白鸽。
notes: Elegiast 依术语表译“悼歌诗人”；Ivory Dove；开放终审：服从前作官中或逐词证据链，修正设定称谓。

source: I have seen your poor spirit, remember, S.H. You are bent by the sign of the Gate.
translation: 我见过你那可怜的灵魂，记得吗，S.H.？门之印已经把你压弯。
notes: bent by the sign of the Gate 保留身体与灵魂同时受压弯的意象；S.H. 原样保留。

source: Spend [q=whi:evolveCost] Moth Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=whi:evolveCost] 份蛾之经历。
notes: 完整保留查询变量；沿前批系统句式。

source: Is there anything I might want to do with the drinks before I take them over?
translation: 把这些酒端过去以前，我要不要先动点手脚？

source: It is now.
translation: 现在是了。
notes: 承接黑市商品是否可查看的问答，保留简短语气。

source: Below the House, the [[little joys of night]].
translation: 居屋之下，[[little joys of night]]。
notes: 保留双中括号链接；House 作为漫宿专名开放终审采用“居屋”。

source: Fifty years ago. How did it die? How did it come here?
translation: 五十年前。它是怎么死的？又怎么来到这里？

source: I will endeavour so not to do.
translation: 我会尽力避免。
notes: 保留奥比耶略显生硬的正式措辞。

source: Impossible ever to say. Our understanding lies buried beneath ignorance, beneath the gravestone knowledge, raised by science and art.
translation: 永远无从断定。我们的理解埋在无知之下，埋在知识这块由科学与艺术立起的墓碑之下。
notes: 保留 knowledge 同 gravestone 构成的阴郁隐喻。

source: You kept that?
translation: 那东西你还留着？

source: Mlle Lagasse travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 拉格斯小姐随一支马戏团旅行。她离团来了这里，又离开这里追上马戏团。马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪，下一站是米马塔。我知道的只有这些。
notes: it 指马戏团而非团员；Rosa Mundi 统一译“罗莎·蒙迪”，保留富文本。

source: Yes. This. Exactly. So I am going to tell you where you will find your Lagasse. And I hope that you will no longer trouble my affairs.
translation: 对。就是这样。正是如此。所以我要告诉你，你会在哪儿找到你那位拉格斯小姐。也希望你从此别再插手我的事务。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: It will be done.
translation: 这事会办妥。

source: Or if you've found for me the customary gift - then that's easier of course for us both.
translation: 或者，如果你替我找到了惯常的礼物——那对我们两人当然都更省事。
notes: customary gift 所指物品未明，正文不作解释。

source: It was a gift to the institution from another guest. Someone who collects curios. I thought he wanted to show his gratitude to us. But I begin to suspect a little prank.
translation: 这是另一位客人送给疗养院的礼物。那人收藏奇珍异物。我本以为他是想向我们表达谢意。但现在，我开始怀疑这是个小小的恶作剧。
notes: 保留源文尾随空格。

source: Yes...
So be it.
translation: 那便如此。

source: Heavens, no. Want company?
translation: 天哪，当然不。想要人陪吗？

source: Stay.
translation: 留下。

source: What price would you accept to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation: 你要什么代价，才肯带我进入医生的梦？

source: [Wait.]
translation: [等候。]

source: Did Aubière put you up to this? Are you spying on me?
translation: 是奥比耶让你来的？你在监视我？

source: François Isnard.
translation: 弗朗索瓦·伊斯纳尔。
notes: 虚构姓名按法语音译。

source: What?
translation: 什么？

source: "...and then she says, 'but then why does the Form have four ends?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说，‘可既然这样，形相为什么有四个端点？’”[停顿，等人发笑]
notes: 保留富文本、方括号动作及尾随空格；源文嵌套引号次序异常，中文按可读方式闭合；Form 开放终审按哲学语境译“形相”。

source: There's no way, now, to fulfil what Zèlia asked of me. Best to nod and pass on by.
translation: 泽莉娅托我办的事，现在是办不成了。最好点点头，径自走过。
notes: k.52 迁移：新增内容人工新译

source: [Buy tickets to Mimata for me and for Vincent.]
translation: [给我和文森特购买去米马塔的车票。]
notes: Mimata 沿前批译“米马塔”。

source: The three candles are a Solar tradition. Linou is invoking three faces of the Sun to look kindly upon the departed.
translation: 三支蜡烛属于太阳传统。莉努正祈求太阳的三张面孔垂顾逝者。
notes: Solar 可能是设定传统专名，开放终审采用“太阳传统”，已完成开放终审。

source: Each keeps two cards hidden until we all slap down our hands. Watch their faces...
translation: 每个人留两张暗牌，等所有人一齐摊牌。看他们的表情……

source: M'sieu.
translation: 先生。
notes: M'sieu 为 monsieur 的口语省音，中文保留简短招呼。

source: [Knock] It has that quality. I wonder what he found there...
translation: [启] 它有那种特质。我很好奇他在那里发现了什么……
notes: Knock 依术语表译“启”。

source: [Consider my Outfit choices.]
translation: [考虑我的装束选择。]
notes: 开放终审：按完整词形族与当前句法统一。

source: A friend of mine - a southern woman - used to dance at the [[Ecdysis Club]] in London. When her heart was broken, she set out to revenge herself. She told me that she had buried a songbird's heart at the dark of a moon, to call for the red help she wanted.
translation: 我有个朋友——南方女人——从前在伦敦的[[Ecdysis Club]]跳舞。情郎负心，她便起身复仇。她告诉我，自己曾在无月之夜埋下一颗鸣禽之心，召请她渴求的赤红援手。
notes: 由 j.18 同文迁移；为蜕衣俱乐部补回运行时链接。

source: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]
notes: 指翻页式闹钟数字牌。

source: (Charming little creature.)
translation: （真是只迷人的小东西。）
notes: 保留圆括号结构。

source: Just looking.
translation: 随便看看。

source: While I know where it is, it can do little harm.
translation: 只要我知道它在哪里，它就兴不起多少祸害。

source: Rise in the dark. [You won't gain the benefits of a restful night's sleep. When you've finished any nightstalking you want to do, return to your bed and sleep the last few hours.]
translation: 在黑暗中起身。[你将无法获得一夜安眠带来的益处。完成所有想做的夜间潜行后，回到床上，睡完最后几个小时。]
notes: 保留句内方括号教程结构；nightstalking 开放终审采用“夜间潜行”。

source: [Applaud graciously.]
translation: [优雅地鼓掌。]

source: [High and perilous knowledge?? Show me, now!]
translation: [高深而危险的知识？？快给我看！]
notes: 保留双问号及方括号结构。

source: Just my little joke.
translation: 只是我开的一个小玩笑。

source: How about Bessy?
translation: 贝茜怎么样？

source: Want company? I'll lend a hand with the flowers.
translation: 要人陪吗？我可以帮忙采花。

source: I have the skills to create a [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] item, which could be useful here. Something to think about.
translation: 凭我的技艺，可以制作[[Hallow]]或[[Unveil]]物品，在这里或许用得上。值得考虑。
notes: Skill 依术语表译“技艺”；保留两个链接目标。

source: I dug Paris. Paris was gone! I mean, the end, you know?
translation: 我可爱死巴黎了。巴黎没了！我的意思是，彻底完了，明白吗？
notes: dug 表示俚俗喜爱，gone 按后续 Enemy came / the end 的语境译为“没了”，保留富文本。

source: [q=alias.last], yes?
translation: [q=alias.last]，对吧？
notes: 查询变量原样保留。

source: Well, I pay a small surcharge. This is the world we live in, Mr Hobson. I trust the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly envy.
translation: 这个嘛，我另付了一点费用。这世道就是如此，霍布森先生。想必此事只在你我之间；我可不愿惹来什么不体面的嫉妒。

source: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我在找一个名叫[[Nina Lagasse]]的女人……
notes: 保留链接目标。

source: Beneath the chin, for instance. And the absurd, magnificent chest-ruff also requires attention.
translation: 比如下巴底下。还有胸前那圈荒唐而华丽的蓬毛，也需要打理。
notes: chest-ruff 指猫胸前的长蓬毛。

source: Is there absolutely no chance of a coffee? I've been desperate for one ever since I got off the train. Awake all night, you see.
translation: 难道真没可能来杯咖啡吗？自从下火车，我就馋得要命。你看，我一整晚没睡。

source: Indeed?
translation: 是吗？

source: Yes. There's something I need from her.
translation: 是的。我有件事需要她帮忙。

source: The director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui smiles at me from behind his desk.
translation: “今日”疗养院的院长坐在书桌后，朝我微笑。
notes: Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 统一译“‘今日’疗养院”，玩家文本使用中文双引号。

source: There's always a reason... but sometimes I like to keep it to myself.
translation: 总有原因……但有时候，我喜欢把它藏在心里。

source: Spend [q=cur:evolveCost] Lantern Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cur:evolveCost] 份灯之经历。
notes: 完整保留查询变量；沿前批系统句式，Lantern 依术语表译“灯”。

source: Yeah, she was here. She left pretty suddenly. I think she got what she needed from the doc.
translation: 对，她来过。走得很突然。我想，她从医生那儿拿到了需要的东西。

source: [Leave]
translation: [离开]
notes: 保留源文无句点的方括号结构。

source: ...sorry.
translation: ……抱歉。

source: What are you talking about? Let go of me, you scoundrel!
translation: 你在说什么？放开我，你这无赖！

source: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot harm you; he cannot find you; he always has what you desire.'
translation: [司辰学]“他伤不了你；他找不到你；他总有你渴望之物。”
notes: HOROMACHISTRY 是玩家可见的对话技艺提示，与其他同场条目统一译“司辰学”。

source: She knows you?
translation: 她认识你？

source: After a few moments, Aubière looks away. He coughs to cover his embarrassment.
translation: 过了片刻，奥比耶移开目光，又咳了一声，想掩饰尴尬。

source: The tricoloured French flag - but the central band is marked with the francisque, the starry double-axe which has become the emblem of the French [[State]].
translation: 法兰西三色旗——但中央色带印着弗朗西斯克，那把星光闪耀的双刃斧如今已成为法兰西[[State]]的徽记。
notes: 保留富文本与双中括号链接；francisque 在此指维希式双刃斧徽号，沿本批音译。

source: Yes. He's in Kerisham.
translation: 是的。他在凯尔伊苏姆。
notes: 沿用《司辰之书》Kerisham 定名“凯尔伊苏姆”。

source: [Casually examine a ten-francisque note] Well, look, I recognise the value of information. If you remembered anything, I would be happy to compensate you...
translation: [随意查看一张十弗朗西斯克纸币] 嗯，你瞧，我明白情报自有价值。你要是想起了什么，我很乐意补偿你……
notes: francisque 作为货币单位沿本批音译“弗朗西斯克”；保留方括号动作。

source: What do I want?
translation: 我想要什么？

source: [On the wall beside the gate, a white bird sits: an albino crow? It cocks its head at me and blinks a gem-black eye.]
translation: [门边墙上栖着一只白鸟：白化乌鸦？它朝我歪着头，眨了眨宝石般乌黑的眼睛。]

source: 1936. A bad year for me.
translation: 1936年。对我来说可不是个好年头。

source: [Settle bill and go.]
translation: [结账离开。]

source: She makes an impression, Mlle Lagasse.
translation: 拉格斯小姐确实令人印象深刻。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: ...that Hobson book? 'The Blood in the Belfry'?
translation: ……霍布森写的那本书？《钟楼中的血》？
notes: The Blood in the Belfry 统一译《钟楼中的血》。

source: I have better things to do than get drunks drunker.
translation: 我有更要紧的事做，没空让醉鬼醉得更厉害。

source: Go on! It's the broom for you! And don't let us see you here again!
translation: 滚！该拿扫帚赶你了！别再让我们看到你！
notes: it's the broom for you 按“拿扫帚赶人／扫地出门”的口语意象处理。

source: Beach-glass. This travelled a long way - rolled and smoothed by Atlantic waves and grey shingle. One traveller knows another.
translation: 沙滩玻璃。这东西走了很远——在大西洋的海浪与灰色卵石间滚磨得圆润光滑。旅人自能认出旅人。
notes: 保留物件与主人公同为 traveller 的照应。

source: Sniff contemptuously.
translation: 轻蔑地嗤鼻。

source: You've returned to Sinombre, Lieutenant S.H. And Sinombre is ready to speak.
translation: 你回到西农布尔身边了，S.H. 中尉。而西农布尔已经准备开口。
notes: Sinombre 统一译“西农布尔”，保留第三人称自称与 S.H. 缩写。

source: I should not, perhaps, have raised the matter. I hope I have not offended.
translation: 我也许不该提起这件事。但愿没有冒犯您。

source: This is... a very gentle pastis.
translation: 这……可真是杯温柔的茴香酒。
notes: gentle 暗示酒味过淡，并承接下一句揭晓其实是维希矿泉水，保留轻微反讽。

source: She leans closer.
translation: 她凑近了些。

source: I can't be bothered with all this. I'll leave the bed half-made.
translation: 我懒得管这么多。床就铺一半吧。

source: The last witch of Lagash! A traitress, a fraud.
translation: 拉格什最后的女巫！一个女叛徒，一个骗子。
notes: 润色2026-08-18：Lagash 统一“拉格什”

source: This appears to be in order, Monsieur Hobson. Unless there was something else?
translation: 这看起来没问题，霍布森先生。除非您还有别的事？
notes: 保留源文开头的一个空格。

source: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Useful.
translation: 一套令人安心、显得友善的服装。很实用。

source: Lie back, drift off; bring the day. [Return to unrestful sleep; wake in the morning.]
translation: 躺回去，任意识飘远；让白昼来临。[重新陷入无法安睡的睡眠；早晨醒来。]
notes: 保留句内方括号教程结构。

source: [The big man folds his arms. He neither moves nor changes expression.]
translation: [大个子抱起双臂。他不动，也不改表情。]
